nl_compose_hint: A one-off email you write yourself, with the same rich-text editor as articles.
nl_compose_recipient_hint: This will be sent to %d confirmed subscriber(s).
nl_digest_hint: Automatic: builds an email from every article published since the last digest and sends it in one click, in small batches.
nl_digest_no_new_articles: No new articles since the last digest.
nl_no_confirmed_subscribers: No confirmed subscribers to send to.
nl_empty_composer: Write a subject and some content first.
nl_confirm_send: Send this newsletter now? This cannot be undone.
nl_digest_error: Something went wrong while sending. Please try again.
nl_settings_show_dashboard_widget: Show subscribers widget on the admin dashboard
nl_digest_template_intro: Customize the email sent when you click "Send digest now". Leave empty to use the built-in default (a short greeting, the articles, and a sign-off). Must include the {articles} placeholder — that's where each new article's image, title, and summary are inserted.
nl_digest_template_summary: This is the layout of the automatic digest email (the one sent by "Send digest now" on the Overview tab): your greeting and sign-off, around the list of new articles. It does not affect newsletters written in Compose.
nl_digest_template_email_note: {name} is the subscriber's name (collected by the signup form when enabled in Settings, otherwise the fallback text). {email} is their address.
nl_subscribers_hint: These are the addresses a newsletter or digest is sent to.
nl_pending_hint: These people signed up but never clicked the confirmation link, so they receive nothing.
nl_settings_hint: The name and address your subscribers see in their inbox.
nl_smtp_test_failed: The test email could not be sent.
nl_smtp_brevo_hint: Fills in the Brevo server (smtp-relay.brevo.com, port 587, STARTTLS) and turns SMTP on. Then enter the SMTP login and SMTP key found in Brevo under SMTP & API (not your account e-mail and password), and use a sender address validated in Brevo, otherwise Brevo rejects the message.
nl_smtp_brevo_applied: Brevo server settings applied. Enter your SMTP login and key, then save.
nl_smtp_intro: By default, this plugin sends emails through your hosting provider's built-in mail server. That works, but delivery quality (spam placement, bounce visibility) varies a lot between hosts — and for a newsletter, ending up in spam defeats the point. Connecting a dedicated SMTP provider (Brevo, Mailjet, Amazon SES, or your email provider's own SMTP) generally improves this. Leave disabled if you're not sure — the plugin will keep working exactly as before.
nl_smtp_enabled: Send emails via SMTP instead of the server's default mail function
nl_smtp_auth: This server requires a username and password
nl_smtp_password_help: Leave empty when saving to keep the currently stored password unchanged. Type a new one to replace it.
nl_smtp_test_help: Sends a short test email using the settings currently saved above (save your changes first). Uses SMTP if enabled, otherwise the server's default mail function.
nl_settings_name_field: Name field on the signup form
nl_settings_name_fallback: Text used when a subscriber has no name
nl_overview_intro: Two ways to email your confirmed subscribers: write a one-off newsletter yourself, or send an automatic digest of your latest articles.
nl_settings_shortcode_hint: Paste this shortcode in any page, article or project to display the signup form.
nl_settings_button_color_default: Use the theme's default button color
nl_compose_tokens_hint: Click a variable to insert it at the cursor. It is replaced for each recipient when sent.
